name: Dancing Line Fan-made Collection
detailed_description:
Gameplay

You need to tap the screen following the rhythm of the music to control the rotation of the line, overcome obstacles and traps until reaching the finish line.

This game contains the following content

  • Multiple built-in levels

  • The Creative Workshop allows you to obtain a wealth of fan-made work resources and play them within this game program.

Regarding the game levels

  • Each level has a different name, theme, and music.

  • Each level has a different difficulty level.

Statement on the nature of the game

This game work is jointly produced by the player community of the mobile game "Dancing Line" published by Cheetah Mobile Inc. It is not for commercial purposes and is permanently free of charge. This game work is jointly produced by the player group of the mobile game "Dancing Line" issued by Cheetah Mobile Inc.

short_description: "Dancing Line Fan-made Collection" will bring you a wonderful music journey. In the game, you need to follow the music rhythm, click the screen to control the rotation of lines, cross obstacles and traps until you reach the end. Each level is a wonderful journey.
